profile.cnpjHint: Every collaborator works as a company (PJ): enter your company's CNPJ.
profile.jobTitleHint: Write it your way, e.g. Account, Production or Strategy Director.
profile.levelHint: How you feel in your role today. It doesn't depend on numbers: it helps us match the right communication.

junior.title: Junior
junior.body: Starting out: learns fast and still relies on day-to-day support.

pleno.title: Mid-level
pleno.body: Handles the day to day alone and has some work with brands.

senior.title: Senior
senior.body: A reference in the role: already works with brands and guides others.

profile.acceptTerms: I have read and accept the Partner Terms
profile.acceptTermsHint: They work as the partnership agreement: you work with us as a company, through the platform.

errors.cnpj: Check the CNPJ: it needs 14 valid digits.
errors.terms: To continue, accept the Partner Terms.

requests.description: People who signed up with the agency e-mail and are waiting for your approval.
requests.empty: No requests waiting right now. When someone signs up with the agency e-mail, it shows up here and in the bell.
requests.roleHint: Collaborator sees the day to day; Manager runs deals; Admin also manages the agency.
requests.banner: {count, plural, one {# person is} other {# people are}} waiting for your approval to join the agency.

gate.title: Complete your details
gate.body: Before continuing, enter your CNPJ, job title and level, and accept the Partner Terms. It takes 1 minute.
gate.editBody: Your partner (company) details. You can update them any time.

access.requestBody: Fill in your details. An administrator of {agency} receives the request and approves your access.
access.pendingBody: The administrators of {agency} have been notified. As soon as they approve, you get a notice and the portal opens for you.
access.rejectedBody: The administrators of {agency} did not approve this request. If it was a mistake, talk to them and send it again.
access.domainTitle: This e-mail can't join as an agency
access.domainBody: Only Groscove e-mails (@groscovegroup.com or @groscoveultra.com) join as an agency. Sign out and sign up with your Groscove e-mail.

segments.levelHint: How you feel in the market today, regardless of numbers. It helps match the right communication with each brand.
segments.sectionHint: The platform uses these segments to suggest the right Hero for each campaign.
